attribution: 静岡県 VIRTUAL SHIZUOKA 点群データ (Shizuoka Prefecture, CC BY 4.0 / ODbL); © OpenStreetMap contributors (ODbL)
method: MMS ~7000 pts/m2 thinned 1/3; LAS classes are height bins only; ground = class 2 median DEM; poles = 0.25 m grid isolated vertical columns >=4 m; trees = green RGB voxels with synthesised trunk; buildings = 3-D connected facade components >=4 m tall, extruded to OSM footprints; roads/sidewalks from OSM

origin.rotationNote: voxel x runs along the street direction (angle rotationDeg CCW from east); voxel z = right-hand side; (x,y) = projected position of voxel (0,0) corner; EPSG:6676 JGD2011 / Japan Plane Rectangular CS VIII

notes: Corridor-shaped: MMS only covers the street and its frontage (~30 m wide). Terrain is solid and only present near scanned ground.
